owner_message_original: Давай пока с моим участием, подготовь, что от меня требуется
owner_message_english_translation: Let's do it with my participation for now; prepare what is required from me.
context: The preceding proposal offered a prepared image/settings package for the owner to generate and export a first shoulder component in Tripo.
authorized_scope: Prepare the first owner-operated Tripo component input and instruction package inside MSQ-54.
operator: Owner performs Tripo generation and export for now; controller prepares inputs and later inspects the returned source.
first_component: Datum16 wearer-right shoulder armor cap, selected as the bounded pilot from the preceding plan.
execution_boundary: No controller Tripo uploads or credit-consuming generation; no automatic dispatch of the complete MSQ-54 model or successor tasks.
acceptance: Derived component art and hidden-surface interpretations are not final owner-approved 3D geometry; MSQ-54 remains incomplete.
